description:
Goal
Make the shared Enum.reduce* bridge closure work over non-List Enumerables (Range, Map) when it lands at the settled_callable_boundary consumer, instead of hard-erroring on a multi-surface callable value.

Current signal
Two minimal programs fail (interp + run + build) with the same hard error class:
- `Enum.reduce(1..7//2, fn (x, acc) -> x * acc end)` (reduce/2 over Range):
  error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]: native callable materialization for CallableId(1) names multiple boundaries [NativeCallableBoundaryId(0), NativeCallableBoundaryId(1), NativeCallableBoundaryId(2)]; a multi-surface callable value must arrive through a publication position
- `Enum.reduce_while(%{2=>:two,1=>:one}, [], fn ({k, v}, acc) -> if k < 2 do {:cont, [v|acc]} else {:halt, acc} end end)` (reduce_while/3 over Map):
  ...CallableId(0) names multiple boundaries [NativeCallableBoundaryId(0), NativeCallableBoundaryId(1)]...

Root analysis
This is the settled_callable_boundary consumer (src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs) refusing a CallableId fact that carries >1 boundary_id. It is the SAME multi-surface callable phenomenon fz-x2n's deterministic_callable_boundary_fallback nominally guards, but at the hard-erroring consumer rather than the publication path. The bridge reducer closure, threaded through the non-List Enumerable impl, accrues multiple boundary surfaces on one callable value and reaches settled_callable_boundary without a single preselected boundary. Distinct from fz-bfh.1 (which is a lane-count mismatch on Range+reduce/3+scalar acc); here the failure is multi-boundary selection, and it fires for reduce/2 over Range and reduce_while/3 over Map (not scalar-acc-specific).

Relationship
- Directly demonstrates the multi-surface condition fz-x2n discusses IS reachable. fz-x2n cannot be cleanly resolved while this hard-errors in the sibling consumer; blocks fz-x2n.
- Shares the shared-bridge capture-correlation root with fz-f98 and fz-bfh.1; coordinate so one correlation/publication fix covers all.

Required work
- Reproduce with the two minimal fixtures above pinned on interp + run + build.
- Ensure a multi-surface callable value either (a) arrives through a publication position naming its surface, or (b) is selected soundly; do not paper over with pick-first.
- Keep the fix generic across the shared Enum.reduce* bridge; do not special-case Range or Map.

Checks
- New focused regressions for reduce/2 over Range and reduce_while/3 over Map, green on all three paths.
- Existing enum_take_drop_split + range_enumerable matrices remain green.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.
title: Enum.reduce/2 over Range and reduce_while/3 over Map hit settled_callable_boundary multi-surface error
